description: This file defines the ModuleDao class in PHP, responsible for managing module entries in the ohrm_module database table within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and filtering modules, as well as handling data group permissions related to modules.

classes.name: ModuleDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing modules within the system, including retrieving module lists, updating statuses, and handling permissions related to modules.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Returns an array of Module entities representing all modules in the database.

methods.name: updateModuleStatus
methods.description: Updates the enabled/disabled status of modules based on an input associative array, dispatching events for status changes.

methods.name: getDisabledModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of module names that are currently disabled.

methods.name: getEnabledModuleNameList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of module names that are currently enabled.

methods.name: updateDataGroupPermissionForWidgetModules
methods.description: Updates read permissions for a specific data group for widget modules.

methods.name: getDataGroupByDataGroupName
methods.description: Fetches a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getUserRolePermissionsByDataGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with a data group by its ID.
